scoring_justification: Full recompute of DFT+DFPT is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; compare agent's reported values to paper's reference values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for structural parameters, dielectric constants, and Born effective charges from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from Table I (structural) and Table II (dielectric and effective charges) of the paper
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from the published tables; cross-checked against the body text
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are the paper's own reported numbers and are needed to compute the tolerance-based score

epsilon_inf_xx.description: High-frequency dielectric constant along a axis

epsilon_inf_zz.description: High-frequency dielectric constant along c axis

Zstar_Ti_xx.description: Born effective charge tensor component xx for Ti

Zstar_Ti_xy.description: Born effective charge tensor component xy for Ti

Zstar_Ti_zz.description: Born effective charge tensor component zz for Ti

Zstar_O_xx.description: Born effective charge tensor component xx for O

Zstar_O_xy.description: Born effective charge tensor component xy for O

Zstar_O_zz.description: Born effective charge tensor component zz for O

zeta1_Ti.description: First principal value (ζ₁*) of effective charge tensor for Ti

zeta2_Ti.description: Second principal value (ζ₂*) of effective charge tensor for Ti

zeta3_Ti.description: Third principal value (ζ₃*) of effective charge tensor for Ti

zeta1_O.description: First principal value (ζ₁*) of effective charge tensor for O

zeta2_O.description: Second principal value (ζ₂*) of effective charge tensor for O

zeta3_O.description: Third principal value (ζ₃*) of effective charge tensor for O

outputs.description: Contains the DFT-LDA and DFPT calculated results: relaxed lattice constants a and c (Å), internal oxygen parameter u, high-frequency dielectric constants ε∞ along a and c, Born effective charge tensor components for Ti and O, and principal values of the effective charge tensors.

output_contract.notes: Scoring uses exact-match policy with relative tolerances (hidden) applied to each field against the paper's reference values. The DFPT step is load-bearing because its outputs depend on the correct relaxed geometry from the preceding relaxation step.

steps.description: Compare every numeric field in results.json to the paper's reported values within relative tolerances; score is the fraction of fields within tolerance.
